SELECT HOUSE_CODE , BIZ_CODE , BIZ_CATEGORY , BIZ_TYPE , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , DEL_FLAG , SELLER_NAME_LOC , IRS_NO , ZIP_CODE , ADDRESS_LOC , PHONE_NO , EMAIL , CEO_NAME_LOC , FOUNDATION_DATE , IF_FLAG FROM SBUPR WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND #DB_OWNER#nvl(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND BIZ_CATEGORY = ${BIZ_CATEGORY} AND BIZ_TYPE = $S{BIZ_TYPE}
AND ( SELLER_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' OR IRS_NO LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' OR CEO_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' )

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , BIZ_CODE , SEQ , USER_ID , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , DEL_FLAG , USER_NAME , EMAIL , PHONE_NO , IF_FLAG FROM SBUPI WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BIZ_CODE = ${BIZ_CODE} AND #DB_OWNER#nvl(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
AND ( USER_ID LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' OR USER_NAME LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' OR EMAIL LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' OR PHONE_NO LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' )
